Harbour tunnel decision due before Christmas

By Priya Nair | 30 Oct 2026, 6:15am

The state government will make a final decision on the second harbour tunnel before Christmas, the transport minister said on Thursday, ending months of speculation about the $4.2 billion project.

Speaking at a press conference in Milsons Point, the minister said geotechnical drilling in the harbour floor was complete and the business case had been handed to cabinet.

This is the most studied piece of road in the country. It is time to decide.

What happens next

  • Cabinet considers the business case in late November
  • Early works could start by the middle of next year
  • Toll prices will be capped for the first five years

The opposition welcomed the timeline but said the funding split with the Commonwealth was still unclear. Read our funding explainer.

Community groups near the proposed portals have asked for further consultation sessions before any early works begin.
